delete.title: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a Space. {{name}} is the Space's name. "Space" is a product noun (a shared area of pages).
delete.description: Introduces the list of what is deleted with the Space.
delete.goes-with: Accessible name of the list of what is deleted with the Space.
delete.items.chats: "Ask" is a product feature's name (the Ask panel, a chat about the Space's pages).
delete.items.shares: Link cards are pages that link elsewhere; their owners keep these items.
delete.items.socios: "Socios" are AI agents; they lose access to the Space.
delete.restore: "Settings → Deleted Spaces" names the Settings page where admins restore it; keep it matching that page's title.
delete.confirm: Label of the text box where the person types the Space's name to confirm. <name> wraps the Space's name, shown in bold; keep the tags.
delete.action: Destructive button that deletes the Space.
delete.deleting: The delete button while the Space is being deleted.
delete.deleted: Toast after the Space is deleted. {{name}} is its name.
dataset.new: Dialog title: makes a new dataset in the Space.
dataset.existing: Dialog title: places a dataset the person already has in the Space.
dataset.description-new: Dialog description. {{space}} is the Space's name.
dataset.description-existing: Dialog description. {{space}} is the Space's name.
dataset.name-placeholder: Placeholder of the new dataset's name box.
dataset.choose-label: Accessible name of the picker of the dataset to add.
dataset.option: An option in the dataset picker: {{title}} is the dataset's name, {{note}} who wrote or owns it (a socio's name, "Written by …" or "Workspace").
dataset.socio: Fallback owner name in the picker for a dataset a socio (AI agent) wrote, when it has no name. "Socio" is a product noun.
dataset.written-by: Owner note in the picker: a plugin wrote the dataset. {{plugin}} is the plugin's name.
dataset.workspace: Owner note in the picker: the dataset is the workspace's, not a person's.
dataset.create: Button that creates the new dataset.
dataset.add: Button that places the chosen dataset in the Space.
dataset.placed: Toast after placing a dataset. {{dataset}} is its name, {{space}} the Space's.
